scope.audit_method: Existing-file hashing, RIFF/VP8L header inspection, packet-probe/decoder-log/manifest comparison, hardlink checks and saved gate-event verification only; no media decoding or new app captures.
scope.clock: Original MP4 packet PTS/DTS and time base only; no UTC or action-clock alignment is inferred.
scope.coverage: Every original video source-frame identity is represented; no sampling, rescaling, cropping or synthetic FPS duplication.
scope.encoding: Full-resolution 1600 x 720 lossless WebP VP8L of the documented FFmpeg BGRA conversion from source YUV.
scope.historical_handoff_flags: Collector-materialized and reviewer fields inside the original dated handoff are historical. All 32 canonical originals were reverified here; current reviewers come from assignments v3.
scope.pixel_review: Zero direct adaptive pixel views by ui_game. Assigned reviewers own direct, reviewed-byte-match and unviewed coverage and all visual conclusions.
scope.qualification: Successful decoding and metadata integrity do not establish concealment order, continuous privacy, visual layout quality or physical-device qualification.
